sources: check_library_029_col04_reference.py supplies the independent fixed-load section integration. check_library_029_col07_splice_reference.py supplies the straight paired contact and link geometry precedent.
method: Independent fixed-load P-M contour replay at each supplied station and every physical reinforcement phase affected by S1 transfer. Supplied second-order U1 actions/revision are fixed inputs, never regenerated. The declared 0.30-eccentricity action pair gives gross stress P/A-6|Mx|/(bD^2)-6|My|/(Db^2)>0 at every supplied station. Geometry and action scaling are specimen assumptions, not IS 456 text.

reinforcement.detailing_basis_reference: COL02 frozen ordinary tie section and reviewed project bend schedule

basis.nonseismic_reference: Ordinary braced specimen; no ductile detailing
basis.action_source_reference: COL04 fixed-P constant-EI worksheet, declared 0.30 eccentricity specimen
basis.end_development_reference: Straight projections into checked adjoining concrete
basis.placement_reference: COL07 specimen end and tie placement
basis.lap_action_continuity_reference: Declared synthetic U1 compression throughout the lap interval. At fixed 500 kN and EI, 0.30 times the COL04 eccentricity record gives moment magnitudes bounded by MID on both axes.

approved_lap_zone.reference: Fixed specimen midpoint compression splice window

contact_assembly.compression_reference: Supplied U1 compression action continuity declaration across 2640--3360 mm

x.restraint_basis: Synthetic braced fixture with the stated effective length

y.restraint_basis: Synthetic braced fixture with the stated effective length

second_order.member_deflection_basis: Supplied COL04 constant-EI second-order moments scaled by 0.30 at fixed P and EI for the smaller eccentricities

expected.contact_pair_basis: two equal 20-mm side-midpoint bars only; 1.10 compression factor is not applied to other bars

drawing.lap_link: S1-LINK at every listed X cross-tie level within the overlap
